title: An Investigation of Translationese in the Generations of Multilingual Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text which has been translated from another language tends to carry with it evidence of translation$\unicode{x2014}$hence, it is often referred to as $\textit{translationese}$. Multilingual large language models (MLLMs) generate text in a variety of languages. However, it is still unclear if MLLMs' generations resemble internal translation (from English or, potentially, other languages) and, thus, result in translationese. Here, we ask the following research questions: (1) Does text generated by MLLMs resemble translationese? (2) How does translationese produced by MLLMs differ from translationese produced through direct translation? We leverage established indicators of translated text to evaluate text generated by state-of-the-art MLLMs in five languages, comparing to both non-translated and human-written baselines in order to isolate translationese from other kinds of interference. translated_title: 多语言大模型生成文本中的翻译腔现象研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：从另一种语言翻译过来的文本往往带有翻译的痕迹，因此常被称为“翻译腔”。多语言大语言模型（MLLMs）能够生成多种语言的文本。然而，目前尚不清楚MLLMs的生成内容是否类似于内部翻译（从英语或可能其他语言）并因此产生翻译腔。在此，我们提出以下研究问题：（1）MLLMs生成的文本是否类似翻译腔？（2）MLLMs产生的翻译腔与直接翻译产生的翻译腔有何不同？我们利用既定的翻译文本指标，评估了五种语言中先进MLLMs生成的文本，并与非翻译和人工撰写的基线进行比较，以将翻译腔与其他类型的干扰区分开来。通过使用高精度的分类模型，我们进行了深入分析。
tldr: 本研究首次系统性地探讨了多语言大模型生成文本中的翻译腔现象，并揭示了其与直接人工翻译产生的翻译腔之间的差异。
en_tdlr: This study systematically investigates translationese in multilingual large language model generations for the first time, revealing differences from translationese produced by direct human translation.
